site_context.locality: Kurttila, Suur-Kauklahti, Espoo 02780 — reverse-geocoded from the supplied operator coordinate; OSM places the mast node itself in the adjacent Saunaniemi/Saunalahti neighbourhood

verdict.headline: Observable on ASCENDING — a compact, coherent mast echo sits above both the LUMO reference scale and the pipeline floor, so the site is usable on that geometry. Geometry-dependent: use must be orbit-stratified.
notes: **ASCENDING** (n=70): γ² median 0.1746 [0.0778, 0.4967], mask median 6 px → compact coherent echo, above the LUMO reference scale and the 0.15 pipeline floor — usable.
ASC coherence exceeds the LUMO ASC reference (0.0617) with a smaller mask (6 vs 19 px) — the signature of a dominant compact scatterer rather than clutter.
**DESCENDING** (n=80): γ² median 0.0258 [0.0089, 0.0604], mask median 11 px → below the LUMO reference scale for this geometry.
DESC coherence sits at or below the documented LUMO single-look clutter floor (~0.04), so those samples carry no usable structural signal even though the mask is large.
This site has **no ground-truth state label**; treat the result only as observability evidence.
